$sources: TMS 402-22 Building Code Requirements for Masonry Structures: Chapter 8 (allowable stress design, the default masonry method) and Chapter 9 (strength design, a wall type's masonryMethod 'strength'), Sec 4.2.2 (elastic moduli); the empirical rules, the seismic detailing and the other masonry rules are the default pack's (BNBC 2020 Part 6 Chapter 7), named as BNBC 2020's
source: TMS 402-22 Chapter 8 (allowable stress design of unreinforced and reinforced masonry) and Chapter 9 (strength design); the rest of the table: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Chapter 7 (the pack it extends)

shear.note: TMS 402-22 Sec 9.3.6 (shear of reinforced masonry in plane): Vnm = 0.083 [4.0 - 1.75 Mu/(Vu dv)] Anv sqrt(f'm) + 0.25 Pu with Mu/(Vu dv) taken from 0 to 1.0 (SI form of the psi equation), Vns = 0.5 (Av/s) fy dv (here 0.5 ρn fy Anv), Vn at most 0.083 x 6 Anv sqrt(f'm) up to Mu/(Vu dv) 0.25 and 0.083 x 4 Anv sqrt(f'm) from 1.0, linear between; γg = 1.0 (fully grouted walls) assumed; no flexure mode

clauses.strengthMethod: TMS 402-22 Chapter 9 (strength design), Sec 9.1.4 (φ), 9.3.2 (design assumptions: εmu 0.0025 clay, 0.0035 concrete masonry, 0.80 f'm over 0.80 c)
clauses.shearWallRange: TMS 402-22 Sec 9.1.9.1 (f'm 10.3-27.6 MPa for concrete masonry in strength design)
clauses.shearWallShear: TMS 402-22 Sec 9.3.6.5 (Vnm, Vns, the maximum Vn)
clauses.shearWallReinforcement: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 7.7.2.6, the default pack's rule
clauses.boundary: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 7.7.2.7, the default pack's rule
clauses.slenderWall: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 7.7.1, Eq 6.7.36, the default pack's rule
clauses.slenderReinforcement: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 7.7.1.1(a), the default pack's rule
clauses.slenderMoment: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 7.7.1.2, Eqs 6.7.37-6.7.38, the default pack's rule
clauses.slenderDeflection: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 7.7.1.3, Eqs 6.7.39-6.7.42, Table 6.7.13, the default pack's rule
clauses.quality: TMS 402-22 Chapter 3 (quality assurance: no reduction of the allowable stresses)
clauses.lateralIncrease: ASCE 7-22 Sec 2.4 (no increase of the allowable stresses for wind or earthquake)
clauses.steel: TMS 402-22 Sec 8.3.3.1 (Fs 20 ksi Grade 40 and 50, 32 ksi Grade 60, 30 ksi joint reinforcement)
clauses.elastic: TMS 402-22 Sec 4.2.2 (Em 700 f'm clay, 900 f'm concrete masonry; Es 200 000 MPa; Ev 0.4 Em)
clauses.slenderness: SAEngine practice: h'/t at most 30 for walls (TMS 402-22 sets no limit; Fa by h/r), 25 for columns (TMS 402-22 Sec 5.3.1.4)
clauses.reinforcedWidth: TMS 402-22 Sec 5.1.2 (effective compressive width per bar)

sources.strength: TMS 402-22 Chapter 9: φ 0.90 axial and flexure of reinforced masonry, 0.80 shear (Sec 9.1.4); εmu 0.0025 (clay masonry; 0.0035 of concrete masonry not used: conservative), stress block 0.80 f'm over 0.80 c (Sec 9.3.2); Pn = 0.80 [0.80 f'm (An - As) + fy As] (Sec 9.3.4.1.1, the slenderness factor not applied to shear walls); shear by Sec 9.3.6.5; the slender wall, reinforcement, boundary and modulus of rupture values are the default pack's
sources.allowable: TMS 402-22 Chapter 8 in SI (1 sqrt(psi) = 0.083 sqrt(MPa)): unreinforced Fa = 0.25 f'm [1 - (h/140r)²] up to h/r 99, 0.25 f'm (70r/h)² above (Sec 8.2.4.1; r = t/sqrt(12) of a solid section: h'/t 40.41, 28.58, 20.21), Fb = 1/3 f'm (Sec 8.2.4.2), Ft Table 8.2.4.2, Fv Sec 8.2.6.2; reinforced Pa with 0.65 Ast Fs (Sec 8.3.4.2.1), Fb = 0.45 f'm (Sec 8.3.4.2.2), Fs 138 / 220 / 207 MPa (Sec 8.3.3.1), Fv = Fvm + Fvs, Fvm = 1/2 [(4.0 - 1.75 M/(V dv)) sqrt(f'm)] + 0.25 P/An, Fvs = 0.5 (Av Fs dv)/(An s), at most 3 sqrt(f'm) up to M/(V dv) 0.25 and 2 sqrt(f'm) from 1.0 (Sec 8.3.5.1; γg = 1.0 fully grouted); beams and the out-of-plane shear with M/(V d) = 1.0 (SAEngine practice); compression steel and bond the default pack's

quality.note: TMS 402-22 sets quality assurance levels (Chapter 3) but does not reduce the allowable stresses without special inspection: the full values are used

lateralIncrease.note: TMS 402-22 has no one-third increase of the allowable stresses for wind or earthquake; the ASD combinations of ASCE 7-22 Sec 2.4 (0.6 W, 0.7 E) apply

flexuralTension.note: TMS 402-22 Table 8.2.4.2 (portland cement / lime mortar): normal to the bed joints 53 psi (solid units) and 33 psi (hollow units, ungrouted) with Type M or S mortar, 40 and 25 psi with Type N; parallel to the bed joints in running bond 106 and 66 psi, Type N 80 and 50 psi. SAEngine practice: the pack's mortar grades M1, M2 taken as Type M or S, M3, M4 as Type N (about 24.5 % less), none for leaner mortars; hollow units grouted take the ungrouted value (conservative)

wallShearPlain.note: TMS 402-22 Sec 8.2.6.2: Fv the least of 1.5 sqrt(f'm) psi, 120 psi and 37 psi + 0.45 Nv/An (running bond not solidly grouted), 60 psi + 0.45 Nv/An (running bond solidly grouted), 15 psi in stack bond (the open end unit case of 37 psi not distinguished: conservative)
